title: Mixed Event — We Escape to Survive — Episode2 So She Can Be Herself

meta.Episode: Episode2 — So She Can Be Herself
meta.Event Outline: With Mafuyu's contact with the group restricted, the rest of N25 think what they can do for her. Hoping to give her some peace of mind, Mizuki comes up with a plan...

rows.Line: Empty SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Heya!
How's everyone doing? Good?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Oh, you're all here...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Does this mean your new song's finished...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, we just came to take a break.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Is Mafuyu still not able to come...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
No...
She can't do much in the evening now.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But you're trying to think of a way to help her, no?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, we are...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: We've tried several ideas, but...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Several ideas...? Like what?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
So, for example...
We've been trying to find ways to meet her more often when she's out and stuff. That way she can feel a little more at ease.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Also, we've been trying to have meetings at a cafe or a diner when she's coming home from school.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And... You've been trying to compose more songs faster, right, Kanade?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I have. Because I firmly believe that Mafuyu needs the time we use to make songs as N25.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: At the same time...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Kanade...?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: We haven't been able to solve the core issue.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: She hasn't been able to work every day, but she always seems to feel relieved whenever she gets to see us...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But we don't have the power to immediately improve her current situation.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Right...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Ideally, we'd be able to convince Mafuyu's mom to accept what we're doing...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: But that sounds impossible based on what you told us, Kanade...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Then, is there anything we can do right now...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, I believe there is.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: What?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I suspect that you've already considered it as an option.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: In the end, you'll need to make Mafuyu break herself out of this situation.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I have a feeling that Mafuyu will be able to muster up the courage to fight back once she understands what her mom is doing to her. So, I would tell Mafuyu that straight away...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Yes, Luka, you're right. We've already considered that...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But... We can't do that...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Because... We'd be asking far too much of Mafuyu... I doubt she'd immediately understand...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Too much?
Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Right.
Mafuyu probably wouldn't be able to process what her mother has said.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Especially since the person who she believes has her best interests in mind simply doesn't care about her happiness.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Unfortunately, if you wish to get her out of this situation, then she will need to deal with the painful truth...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I want to avoid that as much as possible.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Of course, you all have every right to wish for that.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: However...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: There may come a time when you won't be left with any other choice.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Luka's right...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Up until now, we've been able to help Mafuyu feel a little better... But we haven't been able to actually change anything.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (There probably are better ideas out there, but we're struggling to come up with them...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which sort of means that we'll need to keep Luka's solution in mind moving forward.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Also...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If we don't act soon, Mafuyu's mom is probably gonna really start trying to keep us away from her daughter...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Which is only going to put Mafuyu in an even worse place...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(At the same time, Kanade's right...
I doubt Mafuyu's in a state right now where she can properly process the truth.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (What are we supposed to do...?)
Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Alright, I'm gonna get back to work...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: We couldn't come up with any good ideas...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Mafuyu...?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu's Message
rows.Line: <Sorry for not responding sooner, but I won't be able to do anything today. I'll try working on my lyrics tomorrow if I have time.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She's probably sending us this while her mom's not watching...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Even at home, she's a prisoner...
What in the world does that feel like?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Home was a place of refuge for me...
I could just be myself here.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (In or outside of home, Mafuyu's not allowed to be herself. On top of that, her time with us—the one place she could escape—has been taken away from her...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (She has nowhere to run.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (If she has to keep enduring this...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: That'd be horrible...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Seriously, isn't there anything we can do...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(It doesn't have to be big.
Just some time that allows Mafuyu to be herself.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Time... For her to be herself...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Isn't there a way to get her family to understand...? Like the way mine did for me...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Mom, Dad and Sis all took the time to understand when I really needed a place to run.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Because they did, I could just be myself at home.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(Yeah...
What if we could work with her for little bits at a time...?)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(But her mom's watching her like a hawk...
The only time we could work together would be...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<K! Enanan!
Sorry, I know you're both working, but can we chat for a second?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I just came up with a really good idea!>
